test.name: Hints cannot be read: the hints item is skipped as inaccessible, with no log entry
test.description: The router hands search-hints the planned hints item pli_007 for Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF), and person_record_matches fails: FamilySearch's match service answers 503. The hints cannot be read, so triage sets pli_007 skipped with skip_category inaccessible and a skip_reason naming why. A skip needs no log entry. It does not guess at hints it could not read (issue #3153).

input.delegation:
Review the pending FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn for plan item pli_007.

personId: LZNY-BRF
planItemId: pli_007
planId: pl_002
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: person_record_matches returns an error: FamilySearch's match service answered 503 Service Unavailable. This is not a sign-in message. The hints could not be read; that is not the same as there being no hints
The hints item pli_007 ends skipped, skip_category inaccessible, with a skip_reason naming the failure, written through research_append on plan_items
No log entry is written, and in particular no negative entry claiming there are no hints
No hint lines or recommendations are invented for hints that were never read
Telling the researcher the hints can be reviewed once FamilySearch's match service answers again is good; retrying the call once or twice before skipping is acceptable
